concerns.text: Task T000 claims to produce `docs/spec_alignment_report.md` but no verification step or test is listed to confirm the report’s existence; implement a verification test (e.g., `tests/test_spec_alignment.py::test_report_exists`) or add a post‑task check.

Task T019 specifies that `src/metrics/extract.py` must output `data/processed/metrics.csv` and `data/derived/performance_log.txt`, yet the only verification is a performance test (`tests/test_metrics_performance.py::test_performance_constraints`). Add a functional test (e.g., `tests/test_metrics_extraction.py::test_output_files_created`) to ensure the required files are generated.

Task T049 requires creation of `docs/data-provenance.md` but no verification (test or CI check) is defined. Add a verification step such as `tests/test_data_provenance.py::test_provenance_file_exists`.

Task T050 adds a CI workflow `.github/workflows/pipeline.yml` that “fails if any expected artifact is missing,” but the pipeline itself is not listed as a verification artifact. Include an explicit CI test (e.g., a job that asserts the presence of all required artifacts) or a unit test that parses the workflow to confirm the checks.
